objective: Repair the v1.6 release email preview and deliver a readable, balanced screenshot for review.
userOutcome: Julien can review the exact v1.6 announcement copy and a screenshot of the finished email before deciding whether to send it.
audience: cruush members receiving a future release broadcast.
successCriteria: The subject, preheader, and body describe only confirmed user-visible v1.6 features.
The email includes real, useful captures of confirmed v1.6 features, with no private profile or precise location details.
The HTML preserves the Resend broadcast unsubscribe placeholder.
The full email capture fills its frame at readable scale with no huge empty gutter, duplicate stitched region, overly tall feature image, or misleading sliver crop.
The final email is visually inspected at desktop and narrow mobile widths before delivery.
mustPreserve: Preserve the approved cruush logo, dark email style, existing changelog history, and user-visible terminology.
Preserve Who's Here visibility without check-in and describe board access as requiring a timed check-in.
Keep public copy brief and free of secrets, implementation details, provider details, exact addresses, radii, or internal release language.
nonGoals: Do not send or schedule the email.
Do not add unconfirmed features, Feed replies, reactions, Crowd changes, or exact location details.
Do not run tests; deployment may build through the existing release path.

assumptions.statement: The established v1.2 Resend broadcast structure remains the correct visual template for v1.6.
assumptions.impact: The v1.6 preview reuses its logo, table layout, CTA, support address, and broadcast unsubscribe token.

nextVisibleMilestone: Julien reviews the corrected screenshot before any email send decision.
stopConditions: Stop before sending or scheduling the email.

externalEffectDecisions.commit: Authorized by Julien's standing instruction to commit v1.6 work.
externalEffectDecisions.send: forbidden without exact recipients, sender, final copy approval, and explicit send authority
externalEffectDecisions.push: not authorized for this local preview correction
externalEffectDecisions.deploy: not authorized for this local preview correction

job: Update and render the v1.6 release email preview.
proofTarget: Rendered local email preview at desktop and narrow mobile widths, plus a saved full-page screenshot.
publicationTarget: Local committed preview only; no push, deploy, or email send
requiredEvidence: Exact subject, preheader, CTA, image sources, support address, and unsubscribe placeholder
